visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor living room scene. A man in a black t-shirt sits on a light-colored sofa holding a small white cake with a yellow '12' candle towards a Shiba Inu dog sitting next to him. The dog watches the cake intently while the man smiles. A large cushion with a smiling dog face is visible in the background. (2) Close-up on the dog's face as it yawns, then a cut to retro-styled video of the dog as a small puppy playing with a white ball on a tiled indoor floor. (3) Back to the sofa, the man is petting the dog's head with his right hand. A digital graphic of an age chart appears as an overlay, showing the conversion of dog years to human years. (4) Scene shift to a veterinary clinic. A person's hands are shown injecting a syringe into the dog's front leg. Then, the dog is seen lying on its back on an exam table while a vet examines its belly. (5) Outdoor sequence: The Shiba Inu swims in a blue pool wearing a red and black life vest, then chases a ball on a wet poolside area. It is also shown walking on a leash alongside a bright green rice paddy field under bright daylight. (6) Close-up on the dog's muzzle showing white/gray fur around the mouth and eyes, compared to a younger photo. (7) The man holds two large red and white bags of Royal Canin dog food while sitting with the dog. Graphics showing 'S', 'M', and 'L' size product lines appear. (8) A nostalgic montage of the man and dog from 2013, 2018 (in snow), and 2024. Then an AI-filtered image shows them both as very old versions of themselves. (9) Final white screen with the Royal Canin logo and silhouettes of a dog and a cat.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Cheerful piano background music begins. A male voice sings 'Happy Birthday' in Traditional Chinese with high energy. Transition to a friendly conversation between the main male narrator and a slightly higher-pitched, comical male voice (dinosaur avatar). (2) A 'ding' sound effect plays as text overlays appear. The music continues with a steady, upbeat rhythm. The narrator's speech is clear and well-articulated, expressing nostalgia as he talks about the dog's past. (3) The acoustic texture shifts slightly as the narrator describes the dog's age conversion; music volume remains steady. (4) Faint sounds of splashing water and gentle environmental noise can be heard during the swimming and walking segments, layered under the continuous cheerful BGM and clear narration. (5) The music swells as the narrator transitions into a professional tone to present Royal Canin products. The delivery is informative and persuasive. (6) A final soft 'whoosh' sound effect ends the sequence as the brand slogan is voiced over the ending title card.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage -> List-based -> Promotion: The video starts with an emotional celebration of a pet's birthday, transitions into a list of care tips for aging dogs, and concludes with a product endorsement.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To celebrate the 12th birthday of Nana the Shiba Inu, educate pet owners about the needs of senior dogs (checkups, exercise, and diet), and promote Royal Canin senior pet food products.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator actively presents the pet food bags, explains the nutritional benefits for senior dogs, shows a 'Pet Age Calculator' tool, and the brand logo appears prominently at the end.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video combines high emotional value (birthday celebration) with practical pet care advice to seamlessly introduce a commercial product endorsement.
